source: Roland TR-808 service notes, 1st ed. (15 Jun 1981), 3rd printing: p.10 (switch board; main board component side, its edge), p.11 (main board foil side; jack board A), p.12 (power supply, jack board B, voicing board component and foil sides), p.1 (the opened unit); the 400-dpi scans, page px
frame: panel mm (docs/panel.json, its 508 x 305 mm frame): x from the left side as seen from the front, y from the rear edge. Every board as it lies in the unit seen from above, through the panel, component sides up.
levels: 0 is nearest the top panel; from below, a higher level hides a lower one: the switch board under the step keys, the main and voicing boards side by side below it on their pots, the jack boards at the rear panel below those, the power supply on the chassis floor

placement.main: affine fit of its 15 small pots (the midpoints of their mounting lugs, p.11) to the knob centres: 0.22 mm rms
placement.voicing: affine fit of its 8 pots (VR2-VR8 the centres of their drawn rings, VR1 its shaft, p.12) to the knob centres: 0.20 mm rms
placement.switch: similarity fit of its 16 key switches' LED windows (p.10) to the step LEDs: 0.35 mm rms
placement.jacka: x fitted to its five jacks on the rear panel's (0.49 mm rms), one scale for both axes; the jack mouths at y = 2 mm (assumed)
placement.jackb: x fitted to its first eleven jacks on the rear panel's (0.66 mm rms), one scale; the jack mouths at y = 2 mm (assumed)
placement.power: assumed: on the chassis floor where p.1's photo shows it, at jack board A's drawing scale
placement.transformer: assumed: on the chassis floor at the left, as p.1's photo shows it

pad_kinds: 0 round, 1 oval along x, 2 oval along y, 3 a jumper wire's pad (drawn dark)
